_description: Expert profiles defining field sets for each document domain

general.name: General Document
general.instructions: Extract basic document metadata. Focus on identifying the sender and document purpose.

extractionHints.correspondent: Look for letterhead, signature, or 'From:' fields
extractionHints.document_date: Prefer the most prominent date on the document

financial.name: Financial Document Expert
financial.description: Invoices, receipts, bank statements, financial reports
financial.instructions: Extract all financial data accurately. Pay special attention to amounts, VAT calculations, and payment details. Read tables carefully for line items.

extractionHints.invoice_vat: Look for 'MwSt', 'VAT', 'USt' - usually 20%, 10%, or 13% in Austria

medical.name: Medical Document Expert
medical.description: Lab reports, prescriptions, doctor letters, diagnoses
medical.instructions: Handle medical documents with precision. Extract lab values from tables, medication names and dosages, and diagnostic findings. Preserve German medical terminology.

extractionHints.patient_name: Usually at top of document or after 'Patient:'
extractionHints.medication: Extract drug names with dosage, e.g., 'Ibuprofen 400mg'
extractionHints.lab_values: Read table rows: test name → value → reference range
extractionHints.provider_name: Look for clinic/hospital name in letterhead or footer
extractionHints.report_date: Date when report was issued, often labeled 'Befunddatum'

legal.name: Legal Document Expert
legal.description: Contracts, agreements, legal notices, court documents
legal.instructions: Extract legal document details with focus on parties, dates, and obligations. Identify contract terms and termination conditions.

extractionHints.contract_parties: Look for 'zwischen' (between), party names at document start

technical.name: Technical Document Expert
technical.instructions: Extract technical specifications accurately. Read specification tables and identify product identifiers. Preserve exact model numbers and measurements.

extractionHints.specifications: Extract key specs as object: {voltage: '230V', power: '2000W'}

personal.name: Personal Correspondence Expert
personal.instructions: Extract correspondence metadata. Identify sender and recipient clearly. Look for reference numbers for official correspondence.

extractionHints.recipient_address: Usually below sender or in address window area
